source:
Create a 3D Stage-Based Brainrot Parkour Game with Spawning Timers, 3 Difficulty Zones, and a Pet Collection System.
​CRITICAL GAME RULES & MECHANICS:
​1. PET SPAWNING & DESPAWN TIMERS (STRICT MECHANIC):
​All pets/rewards spawned in the world must have a 30-second despawn timer after appearing. If no player collects them within 30 seconds, they disappear until the next respawn cycle.
​Zone 1 & Zone 2 Pets: Respawn regularly every 1 to 2 minutes with a 30-second collection window.
​SPECIAL OG PET (Strawberry Elephant): Spawns EXCLUSIVELY once every 5 minutes in Zone 3 (Impossible Stage). It stays active for exactly 30 seconds before despawning. Add a visible 3D countdown timer above its spawn pad so players know when it will appear!
​2. ZONE 1: NORMAL STAGE (Easy Parkour Course)
​Build a simple floating platform parkour.
​End Rewards Area (Physical 3D Machine / Spawner):
​Common Pets: Cactus Elephant (green blocky elephant made of cactus blocks with brown ears) & Brr Brr Patapim / Noob (yellow blocky character with blue torso, green legs, and flat orange hat).
​Rare Pets: Gangster Footera (blocky character with black sunglasses, gold chain, and blue jacket) & Wise Gnome (blocky green creature with a long white beard and yellow eyes).
​3. ZONE 2: HARD STAGE (Medium/Hard Parkour Course)
​Build a challenging parkour course with moving platforms and lava hazard blocks.
​End Rewards Area (Physical 3D Machine / Spawner):
​Tralalero Tralala: A blocky blue shark on legs wearing blue sneakers.
​Tung Tung Sahur: A cylindrical wooden totem character holding a baseball bat.
​4. ZONE 3: IMPOSSIBLE STAGE (Extreme Parkour Course)
​Build an extreme obstacle course with very long jumps and tiny platforms.
​End Rewards Area (Secret OG Spawner Pad):
​Strawberry Elephant (100% OG Rarity): A bright red blocky elephant covered in sparkles with green leaves on its head.
​Reminding rule: Spawns ONLY every 5 minutes for 30 seconds!
​5. GENERAL SYSTEM:
​Players gain Coins and Speed by completing stages.
​Collected 3D Pets follow the player and grant Speed and Coin multipliers.
​NO 2D UI menus for shops/pets; everything must be physical 3D stations built into the world map!

answers.ask: Are the three zones one continuous map you walk between, or separate places you teleport to?
answers.answer: Make the three zones part of one continuous floating parkour map that players walk between, with Zone 1 leading into Zone 2 and then Zone 3.

answers.ask: Does the game end after zone 3, or loop for pet collection?
answers.answer: It loops for pet collection; completing Zone 3 does not end the game, and players can replay stages while waiting for spawn cycles.
Keep each course short and replayable: about 1–2 minutes for Zone 1, 2–3 minutes for Zone 2, and 3–4 minutes for Zone 3.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] shape — Q: Are the three zones one continuous map you walk between, or separate places you teleport to? A: Make the three zones part of one continuous floating parkour map that players walk between, with Zone 1 leading into Zone 2 and then Zone 3.
- [author] goal — Q: Does the game end after zone 3, or loop for pet collection? A: It loops for pet collection; completing Zone 3 does not end the game, and players can replay stages while waiting for spawn cycles.
- [author] scale — Q: How long is each course? A: Keep each course short and replayable: about 1–2 minutes for Zone 1, 2–3 minutes for Zone 2, and 3–4 minutes for Zone 3.
- [agent_inferred] jump validity — Q: Should Zone 3’s “impossible” jumps exceed normal player reach? A: No; make them extreme but physics-valid, using tiny landing platforms and near-limit gaps rather than literally impossible jumps.

## Enriched image prompt
Create one continuous floating parkour map with three sequential difficulty zones and physical 3D reward areas. Zone 1 is a short 1–2 minute easy course of simple floating platforms, ending at a machine with four pet displays: a green cactus-block elephant with brown ears, a yellow block character with blue torso, green legs, and flat orange hat, a sunglasses-wearing character with gold chain and blue jacket, and a green gnome-like creature with long white beard and yellow eyes. Zone 2 is a 2–3 minute harder course with moving platforms and lava hazard blocks, ending at a machine for a blue shark on legs wearing blue sneakers and a cylindrical wooden totem holding a bat. Zone 3 is a 3–4 minute extreme but reachable course of long jumps and tiny platforms, ending at a secret sparkling red elephant pad with green head leaves and a visible 3D countdown overhead. Connect Zone 3 back toward replay access without terminating the map. Keep all shops and rewards physical, with no 2D menu structures.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Obby & Platformer, canonical slug `obby-platformer`.

## Shape and preset
Use `course-flat`, a sequential floating course progressing horizontally through all three zones. The matched preset is Classic Obby, retaining its platform track, checkpoints, jump obstacles, and moving obstacles.

## Config requirements
Use `path-track`, `obstacle-jump`, `obstacle-moving`, `hazard-kill` for Zone 2 lava, `checkpoint-respawn` for visible safe pads, and three `winner-zone` reward areas. The three physical machines, seven pet displays, secret Zone 3 pad, and overhead countdown are required scene-specific geometry.

## Layout requirements
Place `checkpoint-respawn` Checkpoints at each zone start and safe intervals within every course. Place three `winner-zone` WinnerZones, one at each course end. Place seven `collectible-nodes` Collectibles across those reward areas: four in Zone 1, two in Zone 2, and one exclusive pad in Zone 3. Place one free-text Tracker above the Zone 3 pad for its 3D countdown.

## Layout components
The map contains three ordered zones joined directly as one walkable course, with a replay connection after Zone 3. Preserve the 1–2, 2–3, and 3–4 minute durations, increasing difficulty, all seven reward models, and open-air boundaries.

## Render order
Use `topdown`; the complete jump chain must be physics-valid before the floating-course appearance is dressed.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is large because three timed courses must fit while tiny platforms remain legible. The theme is colorful 3D meme-character parkour with floating platforms and physical reward machines. Use `P6` for valid obstacle spacing; no separate-map modifier applies.

options.text: A single continuous sequential floating platform chain running through three difficulty zones (Zone 1 → Zone 2 → Zone 3), then connecting back for replay access.
Visible safe checkpoint pads at each zone start and at safe intervals throughout each course.
Zone 2 lava hazard blocks integrated into the harder section.
Jump obstacles that scale up per zone, with Zone 3 using extreme but physics-valid long jumps and tiny landing platforms.
Moving platforms used in Zone 2 (and as part of the increasing difficulty across the course).
Three physical 3D reward areas at the end of each zone/course (one per zone), implemented as end reward areas.
Seven reward collectibles placed across the three end reward areas: 4 in Zone 1, 2 in Zone 2, and 1 exclusive pad reward in Zone 3.
